author: Ananya R.
title: Pure and fragrant
body: Cold-pressed smell, light on hair, and absorbs well. Already reordered once.

author: Karthik M.
title: Everyday oil we trust
body: Great for scalp massage. Wish the bottle had a pour spout, otherwise excellent.

author: Meera S.
title: Gentle on sensitive skin
body: No dryness after bathing. The herbal scent is subtle and clean.

author: Rohit P.
title: Clears oil without harshness
body: Face feels fresh, not stripped. Good lather for a natural bar.

author: Divya K.
title: Soft rose finish
body: Lovely fragrance that lasts lightly on skin. Gifted two bars already.

author: Suresh N.
title: Solid neem soap
body: Helped with occasional breakouts. Natural neem aroma, as expected.

author: Priya L.
title: Plants love this
body: Mixes well, holds moisture, and seedlings look healthier this season.

author: Lakshmi V.
title: Bright, clean wash
body: Skin tone looks even after a few weeks. Soft bar, no artificial perfume blast.
